numeric_environment.arithmetic: integer counting and set cardinality only

c1_page0_fidelity.definition: live page-0 id set vs served page-0 id set, Jaccard >= threshold

c2_nonsense_query_zero_rows.definition: a nonsense query returns 0 rows, so a measured zero is a real zero

c3_accepted_record_parity.definition: recomputed served coverage equals the accepted record's counts and zero list

c4_full_text_independence.definition: every zero concept is zero in the served bundle with AND without full_text

c5_scan_horizon_full_windows.definition: every fetched page returned a FULL window (no silent truncation); the horizon and the endpoint's state at it are disclosed
c5_scan_horizon_full_windows.changed_from_v1: V1 demanded that the scan reach the END of the pool; V1 measured that this endpoint's reported total GROWS with the offset, so that demand was unsatisfiable by construction

c6_like_for_like_page0.definition: served page-0 LEXICAL vs live page-0 LEXICAL: identical zero sets and NO concept loses coverage relative to the served bytes
c6_like_for_like_page0.changed_from_v1: V1 compared the served coverage WITH hydrated full_text against the live coverage WITHOUT it - a basis error, not a corpus fact

c7a_oracle_mechanism_proves_reachable.definition: at least one zero concept is reachable by a concept-only query, so the detection mechanism works on live rows

c7b_corpus_term_absence_is_a_class_not_v.definition: a concept the oracle cannot reach is REPORTED as CORPUS_TERM_ABSENCE, never as a vacuous measurement
c7b_corpus_term_absence_is_a_class_not_v.changed_from_v1: V1 conflated 'the corpus does not use this term' with 'the measurement failed'

claim_ceiling: This record attributes ONE accepted failure (the zero-row core concepts of the served German question in packet 39319405429) to one of the frozen cause classes by replaying the product's own recorded request against the live OpenCaseLaw corpus. It does NOT re-issue, weaken or re-score the accepted falsification; that verdict stands unchanged. It does NOT meet, move or re-derive the frozen absolute LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. It does NOT lift any DO-NOT-SERVE order and does NOT certify admission of any packet. It does NOT claim the map helps a jurist. It runs no obsolete universal-174k benchmark. human_gate_ready stays false. The attribution is relative to the DISCLOSED horizon of the scan, and the corpus is live: the same measurement on another day may differ, which is why every number is published with its fidelity control.
